source: PM-001 two-wave RequirementsGathering interview and exact RequirementsGate approval
decisions: ProjectMemoryBaseline is authoritative and provider indexes are derived.
Mem0 is the V1 bounded local-first retrieval and indexing adapter.
CurrentSynopsis.md is the deterministic first semantic context loaded by fresh configured tasks.
Qualitative changes require explicit add, replace, supersede, retain, or reject disposition.
TraceabilityGraph access is mediated by trusted checkpoint-bound Core projections and contributors.
Module memory is invocation-scoped and does not create durable module-agent identities.
The Desktop integration uses an explicit idempotent /conclude command plus next-task recovery rather than an undocumented tab-close hook.
